name: wedding-invite-film
description: Make personalised animated wedding invitation videos (9:16) in a painted street-scroll style: one continuous camera along a hand-painted street, a cloth banner that unrolls with the invitation, zoom-throughs into paintings of every ceremony, a venue banner — set to the couple's song. Customise names, ceremonies, language, photos and the place (16 Indian and international themes or any new one). HTML/CSS/JS + Playwright; paintings via the Atlabs MCP.
